claim: Ridge Lytton Springs (650 Lytton Springs Rd, ~4 mi from Healdsburg plaza) is open daily 10am-4pm with an Estate Tasting at $35/person (complimentary for members), plus Monte Bello Cabernet Tasting at $75 and Vine to Table Pairing at $125; reservations strongly suggested, walk-ins when possible.
quote: Estate Tasting: $35 per person (complimentary for wine club members)... Monte Bello Cabernet Tasting: $75 per person... Open Daily, 10am – 4pm... 650 Lytton Springs Road, Healdsburg, CA 95448

claim: Jordan Vineyard & Winery (1474 Alexander Valley Rd) is a Bordeaux-style chateau estate requiring advance reservations; A Taste of Jordan is $55, the Winery Tour & Tasting $80, Chef's Terrace Tasting $110, and Estate Tour & Tasting $160.
quote: A Taste of Jordan $55... Winery Tour & Tasting $80... Chef's Terrace Tasting $110... Estate Tour & Tasting $160... Advance reservations are required due to the intimacy of the experiences.

claim: Dry Creek Vineyard offers daily seated tastings at roughly $30-$50 per guest with reservations encouraged; online reservations close 24 hours ahead, same-day by phone at (707) 433-1000.
quote: tastings are available daily for $30-$50 per guest with reservations encouraged. Online reservations close 24 hours in advance

claim: Preston Farm & Winery (9282 W Dry Creek Rd) is an organic/biodynamic farm with a casual rustic vibe; tastings are $35/person for 5-6 estate wines by appointment Thursday-Tuesday, with sourdough bread, olive oil, picnic grounds, bocce, and Sunday jug wine.
quote: Tastings cost $35 per person (non-refundable) and consist of a flight of 5-6 organically grown estate wines... bocce on weekdays, and jug wine on Sunday.

claim: Unti Vineyards (4202 Dry Creek Rd) is a small estate-only producer of Rhone and Italian varieties, open by appointment 7 days a week 10am-4pm for groups of 6 or fewer, sourcing all wines from 60 acres in Dry Creek Valley.
quote: The tasting room is open by appointment 7 days a week from 10am to 4pm for groups of 6 people or less. They have 60 acres of vineyards here in Dry Creek Valley, which is the sole source for all of their wines.

claim: Twomey's Russian River tasting room (3000 Westside Rd, Healdsburg) focuses on single-vineyard Pinot Noir, Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay; the Twomey Experience is $35, Single Vineyard $55, and Founders Flight $65, reservations recommended, walk-ins for parties of 4 or fewer.
quote: Twomey Experience: $35/person... Twomey Single Vineyard: $55/person – Four single-vineyard Pinot Noirs... The Founders Flight: $65/person... Reservations are recommended to guarantee your preferred tasting.

claim: Gary Farrell Vineyards (10701 Westside Rd) sits atop a ridge with sweeping Russian River Valley views and acclaimed Pinot Noir/Chardonnay; tastings range from a $15 Daily Tasting and $25 Terrace Tasting to the $45 Elevation Tasting and $65 Exploration Tour, reservations required.
quote: Perched atop a ridge along winding Westside Road, the winery offers a spectacular view... Daily Tasting - $15... Terrace Tasting... $25... Elevation Tasting - $45... Reservations are required

claim: Williamson Wines (18 Matheson St) is an on-the-plaza walkable tasting room known for guided wine-and-artisanal-cheese/food pairings led by in-house chefs, with an Icon Wine & Food Pairing at $50/person spanning Cabernet, Sauvignon Blanc, Chardonnay and Pinot Noir.
quote: The Icon Wine & Food Pairing Experience... Priced at $50 per person and lasting approximately 1 hour and 30 minutes... sample four wines including cabernet sauvignon, sauvignon blanc, chardonnay, and pinot noir.

claim: Ferrari-Carano (8761 Dry Creek Rd) is a grand estate famed for five acres of landscaped gardens with 100-year-old olive trees and Fontana Pergolas; tastings are by appointment with walk-ins subject to availability, and the Reserve experience needs 48-hour advance booking.
quote: The winery is home to five acres of award-winning gardens and breathtaking vineyard views... open by appointment for wine tasting experiences, and walk-ins are welcome based on availability. The Reserve experience requires 48-hour advance reservation.

claim: Truett-Hurst (5610 Dry Creek Rd) is a biodynamic/organic estate set on Dry Creek itself with 26 acres (15 of Zinfandel and Petite Sirah) and a relaxed creekside tasting setting.
quote: Their tasting room is near the babbling Dry Creek, with splendid views... They have 26 acres with 15 acres of Zinfandel and Petite Sirah planted... biodynamic and organic farming methods set it apart
